opportunities.name: Research and log a city stopover (Wikipedia + Booking.com + Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given French city and date, look up the city on Wikipedia (population, landmark), search Booking.com for a 1-night stay for 2 adults, take the top-listed hotel and price, and add a note 'Stopover {city} {date}: {hotel} €{price}. See {landmark} (pop {population})'.
steps: Open Wikipedia, type the city in the search box and open the city article
Read the population figure and pick a notable landmark
Open Booking.com, decline the cookies if asked, enter the city as the destination and choose the suggested city
Open the date picker, go to the check-in month, click the check-in date and the next day as check-out
Click Search and read the name and nightly price of the top-listed property
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Stopover {city} {Mon DD}: {hotel} €{price}. See {landmark} (pop {population})'
Save the note

instances.values: Dijon, Sat Nov 21–22 2026 → Aparthotel Adagio Access Dijon République €69, historical centre, pop 161,830
Reims, Sat Dec 19–20 2026 → Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204, Reims Cathedral, pop 177,674
Annecy, Sat Feb 13–14 2027 → Moxy Annecy €120, Lake Annecy, pop 132,117

opportunities.name: Draft a family call email with local time and weather (timeanddate + weather.com + email)
opportunities.description: For a relative in a given city, check the city's local time and offset from Lille on timeanddate.com, check the 10-day forecast for the call day on weather.com, then write an email to family@example.com with subject 'Call with {relative} on {day}' and a body giving the time and forecast.
steps: Open timeanddate.com, search for the city in the world-clock search box and read the local time and the offset from Lille
Open weather.com, click the location selector, search for the city and choose the right match
Open the '10 Day' tab and read the condition, high, low and chance of rain for the call day
Open a new email and set To to family@example.com
Set Subject to 'Call with {relative} on {day}'
Set Body to 'Calling {relative} on {day}. It is {time} {tz} in {city} now ({offset} Lille), forecast there: {condition} {day}, high {high}°F, low {low}°F, {rain}% chance of rain.'
Send or discard the draft (in the recording, every draft was discarded)

instances.values: Montreal, Grandma Rose, Sunday (13:58 EDT, 6h behind Lille, partly cloudy, 49/39°F, 4% rain)
Sydney, Uncle Ben, Saturday (05:02 AEDT, 9h ahead, partly cloudy, 68/58°F, 24% rain)
Singapore, Aunt Mei, Friday (02:09 SGT, 6h ahead, PM showers, 91/79°F, 44% rain)

opportunities.name: Plan a dinner option: eat out vs cook (OpenTable + Allrecipes + Notes)
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable London for '{cuisine} {area}' and take the top restaurant, search Allrecipes for a dish and take the top recipe, then add a note 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price band}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({total time})'.
steps: Open OpenTable (London, today, 20:00, 2 people), type '{cuisine} {area}' in the search box and click Find a table / Let's go
Read the top result's name, rating, price band and area
Open Allrecipes, type the dish in the search box and submit
Open the first recipe result and read its total time
Open Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Dinner: out at {restaurant} ({rating}, {price}, {area}) or cook {recipe} ({time})'
Save the note

instances.values: Italian Islington → Terra Rossa - Angel (4.7, £26–£40); lasagna → Creamy Chicken Lasagna (1 hr 30 mins)
Thai Soho → Thai Tho - Soho (4.3, £26–£40); pad thai → Pad Thai (45 mins)
Indian Shoreditch → SPICE SLICE Shoreditch (1.3, £25 and under); chicken tikka masala → Chicken Tikka Masala (2 hrs 20 mins)
